current_answer: Start with the frontend task and project context. For one screen or small fix, try a bounded brief and inspect the render before installing a skill. Choose a ready-made skill when it supplies a repeated procedure or specialized workflow; check its agent, source revision, prerequisites, and scope. No listed skill has a pool-run same-project outcome comparison against a no-skill brief.

catalogue_card.question: Do you need a skill for this screen?
catalogue_card.text: For one screen or small fix, start with the route, current design system, real copy, required states, and a rendered check. Add a skill for a repeated procedure or a specialized workflow. This is a task-fit guide, not proof that no skill produces better results.

summary: A short project brief is a no-install first route for a bounded screen change.
Vercel Labs Find Skills permits direct help when no relevant skill exists; its popularity checks do not prove frontend quality.
Use the catalogue to compare task fit, agent support, source revision, prerequisites, and evidence limits.
uncertainty: The no-skill first route has not been tested against listed skills on the same project.
Vercel Labs Find Skills is on mutable main; we inspected but did not execute it.
Community discussions are self-selected and do not establish preference or outcomes.
freshness_note: Source and audience check on 24 October 2026; a clearer no-install decision route, not a measured skill result.
